body: Quick pass (UMA) @ f7d2a0ec: the whole app suite + clippy green on the final head, a lathe on a lathe post byte-identical, no golden moved, body complete. Flagged ready for an independent review at the effort:high tier (posted G-code). Reviewer attention: ~27 lathe tests in 14 suites were themselves posting through the Fanuc mill post (this bug) and now select Fanuc Lathe; existing documents with a lathe on the default Fanuc post now refuse until a lathe post is chosen (intended).

@mkinney - Maintainer's decision (question dialog, 2026-11-12) on the case the review of PR #1265 found still open - a turning operation on a MILL-TURN posted through a milling post: **"Refuse it"**. Rule: a section that turns the work (a turning op or an on-centre drill, as `lathe_voice::voice_of` reads it) is posted only through a turning post; through a milling post it is refused by name, on a mill-turn as on a lathe. Milling and C-axis sections through a milling post on a mill-turn still post. The shipped Mill-turn machine's default post stays as it is. The existing pin `lathe_workholding_mill_post` ("posts at the chuck limit") becomes a refusal test - stricter, not looser.

So blocker 1 of the review above is to be fixed in this PR (one derivation: refuse a work-spindle section when the post's `work_voice` is not turning), together with blocker 2 (the PR body is another PR's and would close #1247 - please replace it, with a `Changelog:` line and the closing keyword for #1232 only) and blocker 3 (keep the plain lathe for the three generate-only tests in `lathe_cross_drill.rs`). Main is frozen at `0757563d` while conflicts are cleared; this fix is wanted as soon as it is clean.
Turned back to draft to push (UMA): the maintainer's mill-turn decision

Rework (UMA) @ d1fec88a - the maintainer's mill-turn decision ("Refuse it") and the review's blockers:

- **Blocker 1 / decision**: `posting_serves::refusal` now also refuses, by name, every section that turns the work (`lathe_voice::on_work_spindle`: a turning op or an on-centre drill) when the machine has a work spindle (lathe or mill-turn) and the post's `work_voice` is not `WorkSpindle`. One derivation, all three post paths (single file, per mount, per op, and their script forms). Milling and C-axis sections on a mill-turn through a milling post still post; the shipped Mill-turn's default post is unchanged.
- Pins: new `post_serves_kind::a_turning_section_on_a_mill_turn_through_a_milling_post_is_refused_by_name` (Haas own post and Fanuc document post; post_mounts, post_per_op, post_setup; nothing written; Fanuc Lathe serves it). `lathe_workholding_mill_post::a_mill_turn_facing_op_through_a_milling_post_is_refused_and_held_to_the_chuck` (was "posts at the chuck limit" - now refused at the limit too). Two more existing pins tightened by the rule: `lathe_work_spindle::a_drill_on_centre_posts_on_the_work_spindle_as_a_lathe_drills` (the mill-turn drill through Fanuc mill is now refused by name) and `lathe_stroke`'s built-in Mill-turn turning job now selects Fanuc Lathe. `a_mill_turn_milling_section_through_a_milling_post_is_not_judged`, the dialect walk and the C-axis suites pass unchanged; no golden, recorded stream or snapshot moved.
- **Blocker 2**: PR body replaced with this PR's own (what changed, pins, not exercised, `Changelog:`), ending `Fixes #1232` only.
- **Blocker 3**: `lathe_cross_drill` generate-only tests back on `kind: "lathe"`; only the posting test uses a mill-turn.
- Note fixed: `turning_contour_stock.rs:77` indent.
- Not addressed (non-blocking notes): the `Undeclared` hint to settle with #1213, a label for a script handed by path, a builtin-mask agreement unit test, the `lathe_workholding_kinds` test name.

Merged `upstream/main` (clean, no conflicts). Gate on the final head: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` - whole app crate, 2313 passed, 0 failed, 20 ignored (heavy lane); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. Left as draft for the main session to re-flag.

Re-flagged ready (UMA) @ d1fec88a after the rework: the maintainer's mill-turn decision is implemented (a turning section on a mill-turn through a milling post is refused by name; milling/C-axis still post); blockers 2 and 3 fixed (body's only closing keyword is Fixes #1232); main merged; quick gate (2313 passed, 0 failed) + clippy green on the final head. Ready for a delta review.

@mkinney - #1213 is merged (main `890de463`), so this PR is next and is wanted: please merge `origin/main` now. Two things in that merge: (1) `posting.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs` and `posting_per_op.rs` conflict with #1213's script-label plumbing - our reviewer resolved it on a scratch branch by keeping THIS PR's plumbing and passing its label as `lathe_voice::at_post`'s fourth argument; the combined tree built and `post_serves_kind`, `plasma_post`, `lathe_workholding_mill_post`, `lathe_workholding_kinds`, `lathe_post`, `lathe_post_refusals`, `lathe_work_spindle`, `per_op_files`, `setup_mounts_post`, `posting` passed. (2) the one line from the re-review: delete the `#[ignore]` on `an_own_milling_post_on_a_lathe_setup_is_refused_by_name` (`crates/app/tests/setup_mounts_post.rs`, arrived with #1222) - it passes on your head. Then it gets a delta review of the merge and goes to the maintainer.
Back to draft to apply the requested changes (merge main with #1213's label passed as lathe_voice::at_post's fourth argument; un-ignore the #1232 pinning test). Will re-flag ready when green.

Requested changes applied (head 7942dd4e).

(1) Merged main: merge commit 4510d91b (`git merge upstream/main`). Conflicts in `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs` and `posting_per_op.rs`, resolved as asked: this PR's plumbing is kept (the `label` carried with each script, the `Script` type and the `serves::refusal` calls), and #1213's script label is passed as `lathe_voice::at_post`'s fourth argument: `label` in `post_script_body`, `label.as_deref()` in `post_each` and `post_per_op_with`. #1213's parallel `names` vec and its 3-tuple per-op scripts are dropped, because this PR's tuples already carry the same name. No other callers of `at_post` exist. `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the PR's own files, plus the one-line test change below.

(2) Removed the `#[ignore = "#1232: ..."]` on `an_own_milling_post_on_a_lathe_setup_is_refused_by_name` in `crates/app/tests/setup_mounts_post.rs`, in its own commit 7942dd4e (`test: run #1232's pinning test un-ignored`, Refs #1232). It now runs and passes.

Tests:
- Named suites: post_serves_kind 5, plasma_post 5, lathe_workholding_mill_post 4, lathe_workholding_kinds 10 (+1 heavy-lane ignore, unchanged), lathe_post 7, lathe_post_refusals 11, lathe_work_spindle 5, per_op_files 9, setup_mounts_post 8 (0 ignored), posting 17. That is 81 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: ok. It ran the whole app suite set (shared `tests/common/bore.rs`): 322 binaries, 2351 passed, 0 failed, 20 ignored (heavy lanes), 14.6 min.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Ready for a delta review.
